post.description: Authenticated dispatch with strict parameters and uncached entry/sleep checks. Connected commands: adventure_start with required string stage_id calls StartStage; rescue_request with required string reason calls EmergencyRescue, including during sleep/cooldown and unfinished work; home_sleep with optional target_home_id calls Sleep; home_wake with no inputs calls Wake. Home sleep is free and accepts dead/fatigued actors under existing service rules; omitted/empty target_home_id retains the actor's own-home default, while a different target is a destination only. Ordinary commands remain blocked during sleep and pending recovery. Early Wake reaches the service and returns HOME_STILL_SLEEPING without recovering; elapsed duration still requires explicit Wake to restore HP/MP/fatigue and clear recovery. GET offers Wake only when ready; awake Wake remains ACTION_UNAVAILABLE. Empty stage_id retains the starter-stage default; empty/blank reason is rejected by Rescue. Other catalog IDs return 501 until connected. Known success/rejection refreshes the shared context; unexpected execution failure returns no context and does not guarantee rollback or safe replay. No idempotency guarantee. Never automatically replay POST to recover a failed observation.

parameters.description: Owned character ID; actor identity cannot be overridden in params
parameters.name: id

requestBody.description: One JSON document, at most 64 KiB; Content-Type must be application/json. adventure_start params accepts only required non-null string stage_id; rescue_request accepts only required non-null string reason. home_sleep accepts only optional string target_home_id; home_wake accepts no fields. Home commands accept omitted params or an empty object. Actor identity comes from the owned path; target_home_id never overrides it.

200.description: Known command success; adventure_start result contains id, character_id, stage_id, started_at, floors_cleared, is_cleared, party_size, resolved and experience_reward, as on POST /adventures. rescue_request returns the existing RescueRecord: id, character_id, reason, penalty_seconds, created_at, including idle/no-op results. home_sleep result reuses the REST sleep response: sleeping, duration_seconds, remaining_seconds, home_character_id, message. home_wake result reuses the REST wake response: success, message, character. Refresh failure preserves success/result with null context and CONTEXT_REFRESH_FAILED.

400.description: Malformed outer JSON uses the existing transport error. Invalid typed params return INVALID_ACTION_PARAMS without execution/context. Rescue service invalid actor ID returns RESCUE_INVALID_CHARACTER_ID with refreshed context when possible.

401.description: Missing or invalid session; no context.

403.description: Authentication/ownership rejection exposes no context. Adventure service rejects level/job-level requirements with ADVENTURE_LEVEL_REQUIRED / ADVENTURE_JOB_LEVEL_REQUIRED and refreshes when possible.

404.description: Unknown ActionID: ACTION_NOT_FOUND. Missing character uses transport error; Adventure/Rescue/Home service character-not-found returns CHARACTER_NOT_FOUND. Home rejects missing/expired destination houses with HOME_HOUSE_NOT_FOUND / HOME_HOUSE_EXPIRED. Known service rejections refresh context when possible.

409.description: Current entry or Sleep/CanWake exclusion: ACTION_UNAVAILABLE. Home service rejections: HOME_ALREADY_SLEEPING, HOME_STILL_SLEEPING (early Wake does not restore vitality), HOME_NOT_SLEEPING. Preserves the recognized rejection and refreshes context when possible.

415.description: Content-Type must be application/json; no execution/context.

422.description: Adventure service rejections: ADVENTURE_STAGE_NOT_FOUND, ADVENTURE_UNCONSCIOUS, ADVENTURE_EXHAUSTED, ADVENTURE_DAILY_LIMIT. Rescue rejects empty/blank reason with RESCUE_INVALID_REASON. Preserves the mapped code and refreshes when possible; current catalog exclusion instead returns 409 ACTION_UNAVAILABLE.

500.description: Authorization read failure uses transport error. ACTION_PREFLIGHT_FAILED stops execution on state-read failure. EXECUTION_FAILED leaves mutation outcome unknown; neither failure returns context.

501.description: Known unconnected ID or unconfigured dependency: ACTION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; no execution/context.
